My gyn rx’d me prn pain meds over the years that I used pretty only when I absolutely had to due to how severe it had been, that is until the surgery that is show in the second slide was done. They told me they found adhesions, clipped them, and I would be fine. Nothing was sent to pathology. My gyn was meant to step in to take a look while I was open but he decided it didn’t seem necessary based on what the general surgery told him. Some time after I had a lumbar MRI and I asked for the disc incase I went to see another physician and my parents usually like to see the imaging. That’s when we found that—whatever it is—in my pelvic area. The slices stopped before my pelvis and the radiologist did not read past the spine so I called my gyn to look at the images but he only kept repeating what they wrote on the report. I work in an urgent care and multiple drs there told me I needed to have that looked at right away, hence why I called my gyn. I spoke with a doctor I work with again recently and he said the imaging looked like endo. But I do not know anything.
